device.name: IKA RET Control Visc hotplate stirrer

facts.text: The class controls an IKA RET Control Visc hotplate stirrer; the command implementation is based on the English manual version 20000004159, pages 31-34
temperature_pv reads IN_PV_1, temperature_sp reads IN_SP_1, and the temperature_sp setter writes OUT_SP_1
The temperature_sp setter targets sensor 1, the medium (external) temperature, and logs the set point in degC
The executioner reads temperature_sp[0] and temperature_pv[0] as floats and logs both in degC
The executioner sets the hotplate temperature through temperature_sp and logs it in degC
stir_rate_pv reads IN_PV_4, stir_rate_sp reads IN_SP_4, and the stir_rate_sp setter writes OUT_SP_4
The stir rate setter converts the value with int() and logs it in RPM
START_1/STOP_1 start/stop the heater and START_4/STOP_4 start/stop the stirrer
start_heater sends START_TEMP, stop_heater sends STOP_TEMP, start_stirrer sends START_STIR, and stop_stirrer sends STOP_STIR
The valueanswer pattern captures a number and a status from a reply
The serial line is configured for 9600 baud, 7 data bits, even parity and RTS/CTS
get_weight sends GET_WEIGHT_PV; the comment says it only works with start weight and takes about 4 seconds, and no line states the unit of the value
set_watch_dog_temp, set_watch_dog_stir_rate and get_hot_plate_temp_current are stubs that return None
get_viscosity_trend is a stub that returns None
